subject.title: feat: ask_user — structured questions from the agent with web card, channel buttons, and text answers

question: Should OpenClaw adopt this `question.*` Gateway service, `operator.questions` scope, and public `question-gateway-runtime` plugin SDK subpath as the canonical provider-neutral human-input contract?
rationale: The PR creates a durable cross-client Gateway and plugin API boundary; tests can validate an implementation, but they cannot choose whether this is the permanent public contract or whether the first landing should remain internal and narrower.

options.title: Adopt after hardening
options.body: Accept this as the canonical direction after the two blocking findings, direct Codex contract check, live channel proof, and upgrade/API documentation are complete.

options.title: Land an internal slice
options.body: Keep the Gateway and agent runtime private initially, deferring the public plugin SDK subpath and broader client contract until the API is calibrated.

options.title: Pause and split
options.body: Separate the Gateway/tool primitive from channel and UI integrations if maintainers do not want to accept the full public surface in one landing.

recommendation.title: Adopt after hardening
recommendation.body: Accept this as the canonical direction after the two blocking findings, direct Codex contract check, live channel proof, and upgrade/API documentation are complete.
